title: Consulting & Training
text:
📊 Statistics using R

R University Business · ⏱ 16–32 hours · 📈 Beginner → Advanced
A foundational course on applied statistics and data analysis with R — from importing and cleaning data, descriptive statistics, and hypothesis testing to visualization and reporting.
Key topics: Introduction to R & RStudio · tidyverse · Descriptive statistics · t-test, ANOVA · Linear & logistic regression · ggplot2 · Reporting with Quarto · Introduction to tidymodels.
Request this course

title: Consulting & Training
text:
🔬 Analyzing Sensory and Consumer Data

University Business · ⏱ 16–24 hours · 📈 Intermediate → Advanced
An in-depth course on analyzing sensory and consumer data — from descriptive analysis and preference mapping to consumer cluster analysis with R.
Key topics: Sensory experiment design · QDA · Sensory ANOVA · Preference mapping (PREFMAP) · PCA · Cluster analysis · Penalty analysis & CATA · SensoMineR & FactoMineR.
Request this course

title: Consulting & Training
section: 🔍 Qualitative and Quantitative Methods in Consumer Science
text:
🔍 Qualitative and Quantitative Methods in Consumer Science

University · ⏱ 24–45 hours · 📈 Beginner → Advanced
A research-methodology course combining qualitative and quantitative approaches. Suitable for undergraduates, master’s students, and PhD candidates.
Key topics: Research philosophy · In-depth interviews & focus groups · Qualitative content analysis · Questionnaire design · Likert scales · SEM · Mixed methods · Research ethics.
Request this course

title: Consulting & Training
section: 🍎 Application of Data Science in the Food Industry
text:
🍎 Application of Data Science in the Food Industry

Business University · ⏱ 8–16 hours · 📈 Beginner → Intermediate
A practical course on applying data science in the food industry — quality control, consumer behavior analysis, and supply-chain forecasting.
Key topics: Overview of data science in food · ML in quality control · Consumer behavior analysis · Supply-chain forecasting · Text mining · Automated dashboards · Real-world case studies · R & Python.
